content.title: 803 | Funding Vehicles Explained: Gifts, Loans, Equity & Bonds - Social Entrepreneurship Course
content.text: Navigating the financial landscape as a social entrepreneur can be challenging. In this lesson, we demystify the spectrum of common funding vehicles, from philanthropic gifts like donations and grants, to repayable options such as loans, equity investments, and the innovative mechanism of social impact bonds (SIBs). Discover the unique characteristics, advantages, and potential drawbacks of each funding type to make informed decisions for your venture. 🎯 Learning Objectives • Identify the four main categories of funding vehicles: gifts, loans, equity, and bonds. • Distinguish between different types of gifts, including donations, grants, and awards, and their implications. • Evaluate the pros and cons of utilizing loans and equity investments for social ventures. • Understand the structure and purpose of Social Impact Bonds (SIBs) as a performance-based funding mechanism. • Recognize the importance of aligning values with funders across all funding types. 📚 About the Course Have you ever wondered what it would be like to create real change? You don't have to start your own organization to make a difference in the world. Everyone can learn the social entrepreneurship mindset and skillset to build social impact. In this course, you will immerse yourself in a social or environmental challenge you want to tackle. You'll start by researching your topic of choice, talking to people, and ideating a potential solution that you can contribute. Then, you'll build a business model around that solution, understanding concepts like measuring social change, ensuring financial viability, funding and pitching. This course is a safe space to experiment and explore. You'll be guided by a ten stage framework to help structure your journey. Along the way, you'll hear from social entrepreneurs around the world through case studies and campus conversations. These include Yale alumni, members of the New Haven community, and global changemakers. Everyone is welcome to join this course!
